timestamp.decision: Retain fixed UTC-06:00. EnergyPlus output reporting uses standard time, but the LBNL EnergyPlus-Modelica CSV Datetime export convention has not been verified. Do not infer civil time from the July sample.

evidence.finding: Output:Variable and Output:Meter timestamps use standard time; daylight saving shifts schedules and controls, not reported timestamps.
evidence.scope: EnergyPlus reporting generally; not proof of this co-simulation CSV export

evidence.finding: Chicago EnergyPlus-Modelica simulation at one-minute sampling; no explicit Datetime timezone convention.
September 2022 inventory documents points and cases, but no UTC offset or daylight-saving export policy was found.

timestamp.verification_required: Dataset-specific model clock configuration and Datetime export code, or explicit confirmation from the dataset authors.
